subject: Cardinal Bio — MAP, evaluation plan & discount path
messages:
From: Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cardinal Bio — kickoff MAP & evaluation timeline

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Liam and I walked away excited about the latency profile and the cost controls you showed. We want to move from evaluation -> pilot -> production on a fairly tight timeline and have sketched a short mutual action plan (attached). High level asks:

- 6-week evaluation with production-like data (we can push masked payloads)
- Pilot for Q4 with 3 models in scope and 50k tokens/day expected ramp
- Requesting pricing clarity for pilot and committed year 1 volume; procurement will ask for a pricing anchor and any ramp discounts

Procurement also has an open question set — I attached a doc with their earliest questions. To keep things moving, can you:

1) Confirm a MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria
2) Share the commercial cadence tied to those milestones (pilot discounts, commit pricing tiers)
3) Flag any approvals you’ll need internally for concession beyond standard discounts

Appreciate it — tentative kickoff meeting next Tuesday afternoon on our side.

Thanks,
Annie Zhao
Director of AI Platforms
Cardinal Bio
Attachment: Cardinal_MAP_draft.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: Liam Turner <liam.turner@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Bio — kickoff MAP & evaluation timeline

Thanks Annie — great to hear the team is aligned. I reviewed the draft MAP and procurement questions. I’ve attached a clean mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) that maps milestones to acceptance criteria and a preliminary commercial grid. Summary below:

MAP highlights:
- Week 0–6: Eval (baseline latency/throughput tests) — acceptance: 95th p99 < 250ms on 4-token stream test
- Week 7–10: Pilot (integration + traffic ramp) — acceptance: production routing & traceability in console
- Post-pilot: Commitment decision point and pricing anchor for year 1

Commercial proposal (initial):
- Pilot rate: hosted API list minus 15% (pilot term)
- Year-1 commits: tiered discounts at 10% / 20% / 28% for $250k / $500k / $1M+ ARR-equivalent
- Early-pay / annual commit adjustments possible (additional 3–5%)

Note on approvals: anything above 30% blended discount requires VP+ and CFO visibility; exceptions >33% route to CEO. If you’re asking for a steeper concession tied to a short ramp, we’ll need an internal approval path.

I propose we run the evaluation this month, get data to feed a short commercial model, then lock a pilot commitment by mid-September. I’ll send over a mutual action plan PDF and a lightweight concessions model.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Liam Turner <liam.turner@cardinalbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>, Procurement <procure@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Bio — kickoff MAP & evaluation timeline

Vivek — quick follow. Procurement is asking whether we can get to ~35% effective discount in year 1 if we commit to a 12-month minimum and staged ramp (50% of projected tokens in Q1, 100% by Q3). They’ve attached a short procurement Q that asks about termination rights, data residency, and SLA credits.

Can you outline what would be required on your side to make a 35% blended discount happen (if anything)? They’re sensitive to budget timing and want to see an exception path.

Thanks,
Liam
Attachment: procurement_questions.docx (docx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cardinal Bio — pricing / 35% discount request — need approval path

Team — forwarding Cardinal Bio’s ask. Key points:

- Account: Cardinal Bio (healthcare genomics) — pilot -> production MAP in process
- Ask: 35% blended discount in year 1 in exchange for 12-month committed spend (they’re projecting ~$900k ARR-equivalent if milestone ramp holds)
- Conditions they want: staged ramp milestones + annual commit + SLA credits and simple termination carveouts tied to missed acceptance criteria

I recommend the following concession structure to evaluate internally (attached CSV):
1) Standard path: up to 25% blended discount for $500k+ commit (SE-approved)
2) Above 25% up to 30%: VP approval required (Karthik)
3) Above 30% up to 35%: CFO endorsement required (Rishi) + one-time rebate mechanics and stricter ramp milestones
4) >35%: CEO exception and legal clearance required

If we move forward, we should:
- Validate Cardinal’s ramp with a short pilot acceptance window
- Draft a one-time rebate schedule (payable on milestone completion) rather than permanent list-rate change
- Limit contract term to 12 months with auto-renewal clause after review

Please review the concessions model I attached and advise next steps. If Rishi is comfortable, we can offer a CFO-signed rebate letter to procurement to close the pilot.

Thanks,
Vivek
Attachment: commercial_concessions_model.csv (csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cardinal Bio — pricing / 35% discount request — need approval path

Vivek — thanks for the clear framing and the concessions model. My read: strategic fit is good and the projected ARR is meaningful, but 35% as a base blended discount across year 1 without tight milestone gating is high. I am comfortable approving up to a 25% blended discount against a $500k+ committed ARR (aligns with quota and commission rules).

For anything between 25–30% I will approve provided we:
- Move concessions into a one-time milestone rebate (not list-rate change)
- Require clawbacks if ramp targets are missed at 90/180 days
- Obvious SOW limits (cap on total rebate amount)

Requests for 30–35% should go to Rishi for CFO sign-off — he will want the modeled ARR, expected cashflow timing, and legal to sign off on termination language. If Rishi signs off, we’ll need a short exec note to attach to the rebate letter.

Happy to be on the customer call Wednesday to help close if you want.

Karthik
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cardinal Bio — pricing / 35% discount request — need approval path

Team — I reviewed the commercial_concessions_model and ran a quick cashflow sensitivity. Short version: I can support a one-time blended effective discount up to 30% provided the following are in place:

1) 12-month minimum committed ARR of $700k with a milestone-based rebate schedule (payable only on attainment)
2) Rebate capped at $150k total and paid on 3 milestone closures at 90/180/270 days
3) Clawback clause if ramp target missed at 270 days (partial repayment over next billing cycle)
4) Legal to sign off on simplified termination language and SLA credit mechanics

I am willing to approve 30% under those constraints. For a 35% blended discount we need CEO sign-off because it materially impacts margin and sets an exception. Vivek — please loop Aditya with the modeling note and a one-paragraph recommendation of why Cardinal is strategic (customer logo, trajectory, partnership potential). If Aditya greenlights 35%, I’ll issue a CFO-signed rebate letter.

Rishi
CFO, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Annie Zhao <annie@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cardinal Bio — pricing / 35% discount request — need approval path

Thanks for the context. Vivek — I’ve reviewed the account brief. Cardinal Bio is an attractive strategic partner in the health/genomics space and the reference value is high. I’m comfortable approving an exception to the standard discount bands and will authorize a one-time blended 35% effective concession, subject to:

- The rebate structure Rishi specified (cap $150k; milestones at 90/180/270 days; clawback at 270 days)
- Legal to include standardized termination and SLA carveouts
- Commercial team confirms the deal economics won’t push our projected margin below the established threshold in the model (Marissa to confirm)

Vivek — please proceed to draft the rebate letter and circulate the CFO-signed copy on close. I’ll sign an executive note if required. Let’s get Cardinal into pilot next week.

Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference
Attachment: signed-sow-template.pdf (pdf)
